notes: Exact Guarneri Evolution data sheet carrying Sonus faber branding and its Arcugnano, Italy address, mirrored by Mono Norway. The sheet identifies the GUARNERI evolution two-way compact stand-mounted system and specifies one 29 mm tweeter plus one 179 mm midrange/woofer (179 mm converted to 7.05 in for the database field; two total drivers). It publishes 40–30,000 Hz frequency response with the Stealth reflex included, 86 dB SPL at 2.83 V/1 m, and 4 ohms nominal impedance. No response tolerance is stated. The sheet's POWER HANDLING entry is a 25–200 W range qualified 'without clipping'; because the schema stores one scalar and the table does not distinguish a scalar continuous/peak rating from a compatible amplifier range, no power value is assigned. The active/passive flag also remains unknown because the sheet does not explicitly label it. No response points or directivity data are imported. Source: https://www.mono.no/media/multicase/documents/sonus%20faber/produktark/sonus_faber_guarneri_evolution_produktblad.pdf.
